labels.page_width_info: Standard matches the design: about 1650px of content on a 1920px screen, with the page margin on each side on smaller screens.
labels.logo_info: E.g. the brand mark. Works with wide, square and tall images. Without an image or logo text, the store name is shown.
labels.favicon_info: Shown in the browser tab. Scaled down to 32 × 32px.
labels.social_whatsapp_info: A wa.me link with your number in international format, e.g. https://wa.me/441234567890
labels.animations_enabled_info: Content fades in as visitors scroll. Visitors who turn on reduced motion in their device settings never see the animation.
labels.animation_info: Not applied to the first section on a page, so the top of the page shows instantly.
labels.menu_card_help: Customises one card in the mega menu. Pick the collection the menu item links to, or, for other menu items, the same link (page, blog, product). For a menu item that links to "#", leave both empty and type its exact name as the Title. Empty fields use the collection's own.
labels.card_title_info: Leave empty to use the menu item name. For "#" menu items, type the exact menu name here.
labels.card_image_info: Leave empty to use the collection image.
labels.card_text_info: Leave empty to use the collection description.
labels.card_link_info: Only for menu items that don't link to a collection.
labels.shop_all_label_info: Leave empty to use Shop all.
labels.shop_all_link_info: Leave empty to use the menu item's own link, set in Navigation. With no link, it points to #.
labels.logo_text_info: Shown after the logo image, e.g. Oro.
labels.logo_text_accent_info: Shown right after the text, in italic and the primary colour, e.g. Skin.
labels.transparent_header_info: Floats over the first section, showing only the buttons, and becomes the full header when visitors scroll.
labels.footer_menu_info: Each top-level menu item becomes a column heading, and its sub-items become the links underneath.
labels.footer_logo_info: The logo comes from Theme settings > Logo.
labels.legal_menu_info: Shown on the right of the bottom row, e.g. Privacy policy, Terms of service, Cookies.
labels.show_wordmark_info: Decorative logo text across the bottom of the footer. Uses the logo text from Theme settings > Logo.
labels.heading: Heading
labels.show_newsletter_info: Sign-ups appear in Customers, tagged "newsletter" and subscribed to email marketing.
labels.enable_follow_on_shop_info: Lets customers follow your store in the Shop app. Appears only when Shop Pay is active.
labels.max_width_info: Long lines are hard to read: Normal keeps lines to about 60 characters.
labels.custom_size_info: The size on a 1920px-wide screen, e.g. the Figma value. It scales down smoothly on smaller screens.
labels.heading_info: Make a word italic to give it the accent style.
labels.heading_tag_info: For page structure, not looks: use H1 once per page for its main title. Use "Paragraph" for decorative text.
labels.new_tab: Open link in a new tab
labels.button_alignment_info: Inside a Row group, the group's alignment places the buttons instead.
labels.image_block_info: To choose what stays in view when the image is cropped, and to add alt text, edit the image in Content > Files.
labels.image_link_info: Makes the whole image clickable. Screen readers read the image's alt text as the link, so describe where it goes.
labels.image_width_info: How much of the available space the image takes.
labels.custom_liquid_info: Paste app snippets or other code (HTML and Liquid). Bad code can break the page, so check the preview after saving.
labels.badges_info: Badges show on product images: Sale and Sold out automatically, plus the badges chosen in each product's "Badges" field. Each badge's own colours are set in Content > Metaobjects > Badges; the default scheme is used for badges without colours. A scheme gives the background, its accent colour the text.
labels.product_list_collection_info: Tip: an automatic collection such as "Badges contains New" keeps this list up to date by itself. Not used by the Tabs layout (each Tab block has its own).
labels.accent_font_info: For decorative lines and brush words, e.g. the hero's script. Try a script font such as Kaushan Script, or an elegant italic such as Cormorant.
labels.italic_style_info: Make words italic in the heading text to style them.
labels.hero_image_info: Full-width photo behind the content. Keep the left side calm (e.g. the cream plaster) so the text stays readable. At least 1920 x 1080 px.
labels.overlay_opacity_info: A tint over the photo in the colour scheme's background, if the text needs more contrast.
labels.products_start_info: Where the product area begins, as a share of the width. The content stays to its left.
labels.hero_products_info: Add product photos and place them on the background picture, e.g. on the shelves. They are hidden on phones.
labels.hero_product_image_info: A product photo with no background (a PNG or WebP cut-out). Leave empty to use the chosen product's own photo. Add the image description (alt text) in Content > Files.
labels.indent_info: Moves the heading to the right, in units of its own text size (1 = one letter height).
labels.hero_decorations_info: Sketches, sparkles and flowers placed around the text. Hidden on small screens.
labels.decoration_color_info: Drawings, sparkles, stars and uploaded icons take this colour. The magnolia and photos keep their own colours.
labels.layer: In front of or behind the text
labels.layer_info: 1 to 9 = behind the text, 11 to 20 = in front of it. A higher number sits on top of a lower one.
labels.decoration_animation_info: Plays on a loop while the page is open (it doesn't need scrolling). Only when Theme settings > Animations is on, and never for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
labels.editor_name_info: Only shown in this sidebar, to tell decorations apart, e.g. "Lipstick, top left". Not shown in your store.
labels.decoration_image_info: Upload your own icon or drawing (PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best), so the hero fits any kind of store.
labels.decoration_tint_info: Paints the icon's shape in the colour above. Turn off to show the image with its own colours (e.g. a photo).
labels.animation_delay_info: Wait before the movement starts. Give decorations different delays so they don't all move at the same time.
labels.text_scaling_info: "Scale with screen" keeps the design's proportions: everything grows on big monitors and shrinks on laptops, with a minimum on phones.
labels.hero_size_info: Size on a 1920px-wide screen. With "Scale with screen" it grows and shrinks with the screen.
labels.content_spacing_info: Gap = the Content block's fixed gap. The other options spread the blocks over the hero's full height, so the space adapts to each screen.
labels.product_label_info: The product's name shown next to it when it is active, e.g. Makeup.
labels.brush_word_info: While this product is showing, this word replaces the handwritten-style word in the headline, e.g. "scent". Leave empty to keep the headline as it is.
labels.rotate_products_info: Products with a label or brush word take turns: their label shows and the headline's brush word changes. Hovering a product shows it and pauses the rotation.
labels.resume_delay_info: How long the rotation waits after the pointer leaves a product.
labels.label_position_info: Moves the name around the image. The default (-4% and 50%) puts it just left of the image, halfway down.
labels.shop_link_info: Choose a collection or a product. Its name shows next to the image, and clicking the image opens its page.
labels.custom_link_info: Fill this only if clicking the image should open another page.
labels.name_tag: Name shown next to the image
labels.label_override_info: Leave empty to show the collection or product name. Type here to use your own words.
labels.highlight_color_info: Colour of the small text above the heading, the arrow and italic words. Gold is hard to read at small sizes: check the contrast.
labels.enable_scene_info: While visitors scroll, the section stays in place, a gold band rises over it, the text turns white and the big photos come in and leave one by one. Not shown when animations are off, for visitors who prefer less motion, or when this is the first section on the page. Top and bottom padding move the text up or down.
labels.scene_length_info: How much scrolling the effect takes, in screen heights. More = slower (400% = four screens).
labels.scene_smoothing_info: Soft and Extra soft let the movement catch up gently after scrolling, which looks smoother with a mouse wheel.
labels.scene_photo_info: Position is the centre of the photo, as a % of the screen. Width is a % of the screen width.
labels.showcase_text_info: Type [images] where the small photos go, [arrow] for the double arrow and [break] for a new line (desktop only). Make words italic to show them in the highlight colour.
labels.product_title_tag_info: Use H1 only on a product page; on the homepage the main heading is elsewhere.
labels.show_dynamic_checkout_info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay and more, depending on your payment settings.
labels.image_banner_image_info: A wide photo, at least 2400px. The focal point you set on the image keeps the subject in view on every screen.
labels.image_banner_scheme_info: Pick a dark scheme (e.g. Dark) so the text is light on the photo.
labels.custom_icon_info: Replaces the icon above. A simple square image or SVG.
labels.trending_heading_info: Italic words (Ctrl+I) show in the accent colour, like "Now".
labels.trending_link_info: Leave empty to link to the chosen collection.
labels.trending_collection_info: An automatic collection (e.g. best sellers) keeps the list up to date. The category shown is each product's type.
labels.show_trending_sheet_info: Figma Manifesto + Trending Now: while scrolling, the banner stays in place, its text slides away and this product list slides in over the photo.
labels.sheet_scene_length_info: How long the scene lasts, in screen heights. Longer = slower.
labels.size_px_info: The size on a large (1920px) screen; it shrinks smoothly on smaller screens.
labels.trending_background_info: Shown behind the list, faded by Image opacity.
labels.blog_stories_link_info: Leave empty to link to the blog above.
labels.story_image_info: Leave empty to use the article's own image.
labels.story_category_info: Leave empty to use the article's first tag.
labels.pill_label_info: Shown only when this story is first (the featured card).
labels.blog_stories_blog_info: Its newest articles fill the stories automatically. Pick an article in a Story block to pin it to that place instead.
labels.story_article_info: Leave empty to show the next newest article from the blog above.
labels.section_width_info: Narrow = 1200px, Wide = the page width (Theme settings > Layout), Widest = almost full width with space at the sides, Full width = edge to edge.
labels.product_panels_collection_info: One strip per product. The short text is the product's Subtitle field, or the start of its description.
labels.panels_fill_screen_info: The section is at least one screen tall with its content in the middle, and the strips grow on tall screens (at least the Strip height above). Desktop only.
labels.panels_card_radius_info: Roundness of the product details card on the open strip. 0 = square corners.
labels.cart_icon_color_info: Pick a dark colour when the product photos have white backgrounds.
labels.cart_options_info: For products with several variants (sizes, shades). Sold-out products always open their page.
labels.avatar_info: A square photo of the reviewer. Without one, their initial is shown.
labels.testimonials_autoplay_info: Shows a pause button. Stops while the visitor points at or tabs into the section, and with reduced motion.
labels.layout_split_info: On large desktops (1700px and wider): width of the avatars and dots versus the review cards. Laptops keep the standard layout.
labels.deck_pill_info: Small label at the top right, e.g. "Fresh this week". Leave empty to hide it.
labels.deck_collection_info: Pick a collection sorted by "Date, new to old" to show the newest products.
labels.deck_badge_info: Shown on every card, e.g. "New". Leave empty to hide it.
labels.deck_buy_label_info: The button on the front card; opens the product page. Leave empty to hide it.
labels.deck_fan_on_scroll_info: The cards start as a stack and spread out into an arc. Off, or with animations off in Theme settings, the fan is always open.
labels.deck_card_size_info: Width of the cards on desktop. Bigger cards overlap more, so the fan still fits the row.
labels.deck_card_height_info: Height of each product card as a percentage of its width. 70% is a wide card, 100% a square, above 100% a tall card.
labels.sheet_scene_style_info: Only with "Show the Trending sheet" on. Sideways: the banner text slides left and the list comes in from the left. Vertical: the banner text slides up and the list rises from the bottom.
labels.sheet_header_slide: Slide in the heading and "View all"
labels.sheet_header_slide_info: Only with the Trending sheet on. Once the list is in place, the heading slides in from the left edge and "View all" from the right edge.
labels.story_size_info: Automatic keeps the design's mosaic (1st featured, 2nd and 3rd small, 4th portrait). Choosing a shape on any story, or adding more than 4 stories, switches to free shapes: cards fill the rows in order. Tip: Featured, Small, Portrait, Small rebuilds the design.
labels.story_zoom_info: How much the photo grows when the visitor points at the card. 100% = no zoom.
labels.story_zoom_point_info: Image focal point: drag it on the image itself (Custom image > Edit), e.g. onto a face. Or pick a direction. While this story is selected, the preview stays zoomed and a dot shows the point.
labels.continue_link_info: Where the "Continue shopping" links go. Leave empty to open all products.
labels.cart_highlight_color_info: The small labels, the breadcrumb, the free-shipping bar and the cart cards. Gold in the design.
labels.free_shipping_threshold_info: An amount in your store's currency, e.g. 200. Keep it the same as your free shipping rate in Settings > Shipping and delivery. The bar only shows when the visitor pays in your store's currency.
labels.show_express_checkout_info: Shop Pay, PayPal, Apple Pay and others, for the payment methods turned on in Settings > Payments.
labels.show_cart_note: Let customers add a note to their order
labels.show_coupons_info: Customers can enter discount codes in the cart. Create the codes in Discounts.
labels.show_gift_wrap_info: Add one "Wrap style" block per wrap (a product, e.g. a gift box). The card only shows when at least one style is set. The message is saved on the order as "Gift message".
labels.wrap_style_product_info: The wrap product: its photo, name and price are shown. Keep it published to the Online Store, or it can't be added to the cart.
labels.gift_saved_heading: Heading once a wrap is added
labels.gift_saved_heading_info: Shown with the chosen wrap, its price and the message.
labels.search_show_recent_info: The visitor's last 5 searches, saved only in their own browser.
labels.search_trending_info: Separate the terms with commas, e.g. Rose perfume, Cloud cleanser. Each one opens the search results.
labels.search_products_info: Up to 3, shown before the visitor types.
labels.search_highlight_color_info: The search field border, the trending chips and the product categories. Gold in the design.
labels.predictive_search_enabled_info: Off: the popup keeps its recent, trending and top picks, and Enter opens the search page.
labels.search_card_info: Used by the product cards in the popup: top picks and results.
labels.search_show_in_header_info: The magnifier button and its popup. Off: no search button in the header.
labels.header_search_info: Search button and popup: Theme settings → Search.
labels.cart_empty_info: Shown when the bag is empty. To add more under it, add sections below this one with "Only when the cart is empty" on: a Product list ("You might love") or Collection tiles ("Where would you like to start?").
labels.product_list_layout_info: Tabs: add a Tab block per tab, each with its own collection.
labels.product_list_only_empty_cart: Only when the cart is empty
labels.product_list_only_empty_cart_info: For the cart page: shown only while the cart is empty.
labels.product_tab_label_info: Leave empty to use the collection name.
labels.cart_empty_button_label_info: Links to the Continue shopping link above.
labels.tile_info: Pick a collection or a product. When both are picked, the product is used.
labels.tile_image_info: Optional. Leave empty to use the collection or product image.
labels.banner_sentence_info: Optional. Type [image_1], [image_2] or [image_3] where a small photo goes, and [break] for a new line (desktop only). Make words italic to show them in the highlight colour. Empty = the collection title is shown big instead.
labels.banner_photo_size: Photo size (100% = as tall as the text)
labels.banner_image_info: Shown on every collection, unless "Use the collection's own image" is on and the collection has one (Products > Collections > the collection > Image).
labels.show_collection_title_info: Only needed when the page has no Collection banner: every collection page needs its title once.
labels.collection_layout_info: Bento = the design's mix of large and small tiles (desktop). Phones always show 2 per row.
labels.products_per_page_info: Bento repeats every 22 products, so 22 or 44 fill the pattern exactly.
labels.show_card_details_info: On desktop, pointing at a card (or tabbing to it) slides up the rating, a short description and the cart button.
labels.show_card_rating_info: Needs a product review app (e.g. Judge.me). Shopify has no ratings of its own; the rating stays hidden until an app adds one.
labels.category_pills_menu_info: Each link in this menu becomes a pill, with its collection's product count. Make one in Content > Menus (e.g. Fragrance, Makeup, Skincare). The pill for the page you're on is highlighted.
labels.collections_per_page_info: Bento repeats every 12 collections, so 12 or 24 fill its pattern exactly.
labels.card_radius_info: Rounds the photo of each collection and the banner.
labels.show_empty_collections_info: Hidden empty collections still take a place when the pages are counted, so a page can show fewer. To keep every page full, remove empty collections from the Online Store sales channel.
labels.search_suggestions_menu_info: Shown as pills when nothing has been searched yet and under "No results".
labels.search_suggestions_collection_info: The first 4 products are shown under the categories.
labels.show_filters_info: Choose which filters appear, and their order, in the Search & Discovery app.
labels.collection_empty_products_info: Shown under the message when a collection has no products yet (first 4). Leave empty to show only the message.
labels.banner_title_position_info: The title is the page's main heading. It's shown small when there is a sentence, big when there isn't.
labels.banner_line_indent_info: How far each line starts in from the left (1em = the width of one letter M). Lines are made with [break]. Desktop only: on smaller screens the text wraps on its own.
labels.banner_photo_shift_info: Negative = up, positive = down (% of the photo's height). The text doesn't move.
labels.banner_under_header: Start at the top of the page
labels.banner_under_header_info: The banner's colour and the large image go up behind the header, as in the design.
labels.banner_use_collection_image_info: When the collection has an image, show it instead of the image below. Turn off to show the image below on every collection (e.g. one cut-out photo).
labels.banner_image_width: Large image width (% of the screen)
labels.banner_highlight_info: Breadcrumb, small title and italic words. Leave empty to use the colour scheme's accent.
labels.tile_label_info: Optional. Leave empty to use the collection or product name.
labels.contact_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent colour. Empty: the page title.
labels.contact_text_info: Empty: the page's own content (Online Store > Pages).
labels.contact_topics_info: Separate topics with commas. Empty: no topic choice.
labels.channel_status_info: Short line with a pulsing dot, e.g. "Online now". Empty: hidden.
labels.channel_link_info: For a chat app or any other page. Email, phone and WhatsApp links are made for you from their own fields.
labels.italic_accent_info: Italic words show in the accent colour.
labels.show_map_filters_info: One button per location type that has pins, shown when there are at least two types.
labels.map_image_info: Empty: the theme's night world map. Pins are placed in % of this image.
labels.map_focus_info: Which part of the map stays visible when the shape crops it. Pins move with it.
labels.pin_position_info: % of the map image: 0 = left / top edge, 100 = right / bottom edge.
labels.location_code_info: 2–3 letters, e.g. a country code (FR, US, JP). Empty: no badge.
labels.map_link_info: Optional, e.g. a Google Maps link. The whole card becomes clickable.
labels.social_link_info: Empty: the link from Theme settings > Social media. No link: the card is not clickable.
labels.fill_screen_info: The section is at least as tall as the screen, with its content in the middle.
labels.filter_labels_info: Buttons show only for types that have pins, and only when there are at least two.
labels.scale_screen_info: Cards, icons and fields grow and shrink with the screen like the Figma (as in the hero). Text uses the Text size below. Off: the theme's usual sizes.
labels.text_scale_info: The theme's normal text sizes, made bigger by this much. 100% = normal.
labels.whatsapp_message_info: Optional. WhatsApp opens the chat with this text already typed, e.g. "Hello Oroskin, I have a question".
labels.whatsapp_help: Customers who click the link start a WhatsApp chat with this number. Messages arrive in your WhatsApp app, not in Shopify.
labels.channel_email_info: E.g. hello@yourstore.com. Empty: your store email (Settings > General).
labels.channel_phone_info: With the country code, e.g. +44 20 7946 0958. Visitors on a phone can tap to call.
labels.channel_whatsapp_info: The number your WhatsApp account uses, with the country code, e.g. +44 20 7946 0958.
labels.filter_types_info: One filter button per type, separated by commas, e.g. Flagship stores, Offices, Pop-ups, Warehouses. Give each pin its types in the pin's own settings.
labels.pin_types_info: One or more names from the section's Location types, separated by commas, e.g. Offices or Offices, Flagship stores.
labels.blog_hero_heading_info: Italic words show in the accent colour, on their own line. Empty: the blog title.
labels.counters_info: Each value is counted from your blog automatically. Type a value only to replace the count (e.g. "100+").
labels.articles_value_info: Empty: the blog's number of articles.
labels.authors_value_info: Empty: the number of different authors among your 50 newest articles (Shopify has no author count, and a page can read at most 50 articles).
labels.topics_value_info: Empty: the number of tags on the blog's articles (each tag is a topic).
labels.float_cards_info: A slow up-and-down movement. Turned off for visitors who ask for reduced motion.
labels.trending_views_info: Your own text, e.g. "142k views". Shopify doesn't count article views. Leave empty to hide.
labels.trending_blog_link_info: Leave empty to hide "View all" (the blog itself is the page the visitor is on).
labels.trending_rows_info: Add Trending article blocks to choose the rows (up to 5). With no blocks, the blog's 5 newest articles show.
labels.show_meta_topic: Show topic in the meta line
labels.show_meta_topic_info: Off by default: the topic is already in the pill.
labels.reading_speed_info: Shopify has no read time, so it's estimated from the article's word count at this many words per minute.
labels.video_url_info: Used when no video is uploaded.
labels.video_poster_info: Shown before the video plays. Empty = the uploaded video's own preview image.
labels.trending_animation_info: How the video comes in. The rows fade up one after another. Off on the first section of a page.
labels.show_video_info: Off: the Trending panel uses the full width.
labels.show_blog_search_info: Searches articles only, on the search page.
labels.show_topic_pills_info: One pill per article tag, plus "All". Add tags to articles to create topics.
labels.sticky_toolbar_info: The search and the pills stay in view while the visitor scrolls the list.
labels.show_featured_info: Page 1 only, when no topic is chosen.
labels.featured_article_info: Leave empty to feature the newest article. The featured article isn't repeated in the cards below.
labels.blog_layout_info: Mixed: rows of three with one wide card, as in the design. Even: three equal columns.
labels.articles_per_page_info: Not counting the featured story. When the newest article is featured, page 1 shows one card fewer.
labels.topic_color_scheme_info: The badge on each image uses this scheme's background with its accent colour for the text.
labels.arrow_color_scheme_info: The ↗ buttons use this scheme's button colours.
labels.article_hero_help: The image, title, summary, author and date come from the article (Online Store > Blog posts). Title highlight: fill in the article's "Title highlight" field (Custom data) with words from the title, e.g. "Golden Hour", to show them in the accent colour. Topic: the article's first tag.
labels.show_article_topic_info: The article's first tag, as a pill above the title.
labels.show_share_button_info: Shows the share icons (copy link, Facebook, WhatsApp, X, Instagram) on hover, or after a click or tap.
labels.article_help: The text comes from the article (Online Store > Blog posts). How the editor's formats show: the first paragraph is the lead. Heading 2 = a section heading (put a word in italic to show it in the accent colour), with a Heading 6 right above it as its small label. Quote = quote card; a last line starting with "—" is the name under it. A quote with a bullet list inside = tips box, its first line the title. An image followed by an all-italic paragraph = the caption on the image. Numbered list whose items are a bold word, a line break (Shift + Enter), a title, a line break and the text = numbered steps. A paragraph with only [products] = where the product rows go. Products: the article's "Products" field (Custom data).
labels.show_author_card_info: The author's name, with the photo and bio of the staff account that wrote it (Settings > Users), or initials.
labels.show_contents_info: Links to the article's Heading 2s. Tablets and phones show it as a box above the text.
labels.show_article_products_info: The first 2 products of the article's "Products" field (Custom data), with Add to cart.
labels.sticky_sidebar_info: The sidebar scrolls with the page until its end is in view, then stays there while the visitor reads.
labels.show_author_bio_info: Only when the staff account that wrote the article has a bio.
labels.article_comments_help: Shows only when the blog allows comments (Online Store > Blog posts > Manage blogs). Only approved comments are listed; name and email are required by Shopify.
labels.article_related_help: Shows articles from the same blog: first those with the same topic (the article's first tag), then the newest. The article itself is never shown.
labels.align_with_article_text: Line up with the article text
labels.align_with_article_text_info: From 1200px wide, the comments use the article's text column and leave the sidebar's column empty.
labels.show_edit_rows: Show product rows in the text
labels.show_edit_rows_info: All products of the article's "Products" field, as rows with Add to cart, where the text has a paragraph with only [products] (no such paragraph: after the text).

italic_style.brush: Brush (accent font on a red brush)

decoration_animation.rock: Tilt to one side and back

deck_fan_style.auto: Play once when the section appears

social_icon_style.brand: Brand colours (Instagram, X, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn)
